evidence: Expected: ISSUE-0006 acceptance criteria require independently verifiable compile, unittest, governance, clean-checkout, and application-run evidence against the reviewed candidate.

Observed: unittest exited 1 after 80 tests because 19 tests could not bind loopback sockets; py_compile exited 1 because bytecode output was prohibited; governance validation exited 1 because no writable temporary directory existed; the application walkthrough could not be executed.
The handoff records successful author-side runs, but those summaries are not independently inspectable raw command evidence. The sandbox failures do not establish a product defect.
findings.remediation: Provide durable raw command or CI evidence bound to the exact reviewed candidate, or apply DECISION-004 through the documented human-controlled gate outside this review. No product-source repair is implied by the sandbox failures.
findings.title: Required execution evidence cannot be independently verified
findings.verification: In an environment permitting loopback sockets, bytecode output, and temporary files, run the exact compile, unittest, governance, fresh-clone, and documented application checks against the chosen candidate SHA; preserve commit identity, commands, exit statuses, and relevant raw output.

evidence: Expected: the durable current-state index must identify one exact candidate and one unambiguous next review action.

Observed: CURRENT.md line 29 says e95edf2b4cb5b3e420846e10cd340eeaa9158bec is awaiting review of that exact SHA, while line 36 instructs review of current HEAD, which the launcher bound as d15f47c5fb15f4c929dae603afbc622baaeea428.
The e95edf2 object is unavailable in this isolated checkout, preventing comparison of the claimed metadata-only delta, and the target commit has no parent from which that delta can be established.
CURRENT.md line 31 also says the e95edf2 report has a response, but no corresponding response file exists.
findings.remediation: Reconcile the durable records to distinguish the reviewed product SHA from the metadata-only SHA, name the exact SHA the next launcher invocation must review, and remove or add evidence for the nonexistent response claim. Because the recorded repair budget is already exceeded, obtain any required human authorization before another repair.
findings.title: Current-state record identifies conflicting review candidates and missing evidence
findings.verification: From a fresh isolated checkout, confirm CURRENT.md consistently names the product candidate, metadata commit, exact next review target, and available response artifacts; ensure every referenced commit and response is present and inspectable.

limitations: The target is a parentless isolated snapshot and the supplied base is not its ancestor; both trees and their explicit diff were available, but commit ancestry could not validate base identity.
The referenced product commit e95edf2b4cb5b3e420846e10cd340eeaa9158bec is absent, so the claim that d15f47c5fb15f4c929dae603afbc622baaeea428 is metadata-only relative to it could not be verified.
The read-only, socket-restricted environment prevented successful execution of all required checks. These environmental failures do not demonstrate a product regression.
Live Microsoft authentication and Graph fetching were not attempted because they are protected, tenant-specific actions.
No browser-based walkthrough or clean-clone run was possible in this environment.
review.summary: BLOCKED. The README changes appear substantively accurate and no product source changed, but required execution evidence cannot be independently verified. The durable status record also conflicts over whether e95edf2 or the launcher-bound d15f47c target is awaiting review, references an unavailable commit, and claims a response artifact that is absent.
